subject: [PATCH v4 16/19] selftests/mm: add khugepaged race harness

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest to the Linux kernel called khugepaged_race, which tests the khugepaged functionality under concurrent access from multiple threads. The test harness simulates various scenarios such as faults, GUP (get user pages), fork, mremap, and zapping through a protocol of locks, TLB flushes, and refcount checks. The test is designed to exercise khugepaged under contention and collapse serializes against faults. It uses six racing threads working on the same address space, with one of three drivers (stepped, free, or madvise) running in turn unless specified otherwise. The test also includes assertions from DEBUG_VM, page_table_check, KASAN, and lockdep to ensure correctness.
